svg.title: Bedframe adapter: nominal one-inch locator marking reference, 1:1
svg.desc: A4 landscape reference. Four locator centres form a 64 by 13.0 millimetre pattern on a nominal 25.4 millimetre-high rail. Installed main-half axial extent is 98 millimetres. Register both halves in place; separate keys enter from +X. Verify local key, nut, driver and -X pusher access. This is not a validated drill guide. Check both 100 millimetre calibration bars at actual print size.
svg.metadata: Default source parameters: RailWidth=25.4; RailHeight=25.4; LocatorBoltX=32; LocatorBoltZ=6.5; SleeveHoleDiameter=8.2; SleeveBarrelDiameter=8.0; installed main-half X=-49..49; two separate keystones enter from +X after main halves register in place. Model SHA256 807e757c072a347f9ef6e0055835504915d9843f1c53c0a5f7f0dfef49138b8e; key model SHA256 1d7e445dcaad9f9240d9191dffcf0073cc6e178709a0d227d30da3d927fe262a. Marking/reference only; physical frame fit, full assembly motion and drilling process are unverified.
svg.text: BEDFRAME ADAPTER · LOCATOR REFERENCE
Nominal 25.4 × 25.4 mm rail · four M5 locator axes · dimensions in mm · 1:1 at actual size
MARKING REFERENCE — NOT A VALIDATED DRILL GUIDE
Register halves in place; insert separate keys from +X
98.00 installed extent · X=±49
Main axial extent only; check local key, nut, driver and -X pusher access.
Collar centre X=0 · rail mid-height Z=0
25.40 nominal rail height
Centres: X=±32.00; Z=±6.50. Circles show nominal Ø8.20 through bores.
Before transferring centres
Measure actual rail and fitted prints.
Locate the measured rail mid-height.
Set the chosen collar centre X=0.
Check legs, slats and both rail faces.
Actual frame differs?
Regenerate centres from its fitted model.
Do not scale this sheet to change tube size.
Key access
Remove both primary M5 shafts
before pulling the keys toward +X.
Transfer → fixture → drill → deburr → hand-fit
1. Seat/register the adapter; calibrated fitted pads may transfer centres. Remove ABS parts before metal drilling.
2. With a proper guide/fixture normal to the rail face, pilot and enlarge BOTH walls in the SAME setup.
3. Deburr inside and outside faces of both walls from outside; remove swarf. Confirm an accessible method first.
4. Refit/register the adapter. Each complete Ø8.00 limiter must pass both pads and both walls by hand.
5. Never use the bolt to pull a binding limiter into place. Fit all adapter/locator hardware before the PitClamp.
Ø8.20 bore minus Ø8.00 body leaves 0.100 mm nominal radial clearance before errors.
Paper marks and ABS pad holes do not ensure coaxiality or that clearance. Actual tooling, alignment and fit need verification.
Check scale before using any centre marks
100.00 mm calibration bar
100.00 mm vertical calibration
Print at actual size; disable fit-to-page.
Confirm both calibration bars on the physical print.
Prototype reference · 2026-10-19 · actual tube wall/corners, printed fit and drilling process remain unverified.
